en: Black‑and‑white photograph of a large, ornate stone institutional building in late 19th‑century historicist style. The façade has three main stories with rusticated ground floor, arched windows, and a richly decorated central section with pediment, statues, and balustrades. A wrought‑iron fence and low stone wall line the street in front, with trees and shrubs along the sidewalk. The image has the appearance of an early 20th‑century architectural postcard.
